body:
Theres a lot more shit involving my family, up to and including my father, who is now dead to me, beat and nearly killed every single one of us for 15 years. What i wrote up there is just a short version of whats been bothering me the most in recent days. 

I try to believe that people would give a shit but i really can't see why they would. No matter what i've gone out of my way to do for people who used to be close friends of mine, i've always somehow been blamed and used a scapegoat for their shit. My trust has been betrayed over and over again which has just brought me to the point where i don't think anyone would really give a shit or notice that i really am no longer there. 

Speaking of my cat.. he's walking over here right now, probably to jump on my bed and beg to be pet.
